player_prompt.intro:
I chuan GameOfPureStrategy khelhnaah Player {player_id} i ni.
- Ka kutah card 13 A-K i nei a, card tinreng chu vawi khat chiah hman theih a ni.
- Round tinrengah prize card pakhat zela hawn a ni. Bracket chhunga awm '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' tih ang chi chu ziakin card pakhat chiah khel tur a ni.
- Card sang zawk chuan prize (leh carry-over) a la dawn. Inneih loh chuan prize chu next rounda tan turin dah that a ni.
- Round 13 hnuah total sang ber chuan a chak dawn.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Action-ah hian bracketed card token khat chiah a awm tur a ni.
invalid_move.card_not_held: Chu card chu i nei tawh lo.

outcome.draw: An pahnih chuan an score {s0} a.
